invariants.rationale: partitionPath is used as an argument in new BucketInfo and may be expected to be non-null to avoid NPE.
fileIdHint is used as a key in a HashMap and as an argument in new BucketInfo, so it may be required to be non-null.
partitionPath generally likely identifies a partition and may not be empty.
fileIdHint typically serves as an identifier and empty string may be meaningless.
Partition paths often represent file paths, which usually don't contain spaces.
